variables.name: metadatabase_server
variables.note: only relevant for Azure SQL MetaDB

variables.name: metadatabase_name
variables.note: DB_Metadata for Fabric, otherwise name from azure portal for Azure SQL DB

variables.name: keyvault_url
variables.note: only relevant for Azure SQL DB

variables.name: kv_secretname
variables.note: Name of the key vault that contains the service principle secret

variables.name: DataWorkspaceName
variables.note: Workspace where Lakehouses and MetaDB reside

variables.name: ETLWorkspaceName
variables.note: Workspace where ETL pipelines and notebooks run

variables.name: MetadataDatabaseConnection
variables.note: Connection used to connect to the MetaDB

variables.name: LH_Bronze_ID
variables.note: Item GUID of LH_Bronze in the Data workspace. Consumed by the lineage module via PL_Lineage; harvest per environment with workspace_setup/export_all_fabric_ids.py.

variables.name: LH_Silver_ID
variables.note: Item GUID of LH_Silver in the Data workspace. Consumed by the lineage module via PL_Lineage.

variables.name: LH_Gold_ID
variables.note: Item GUID of LH_Gold in the Data workspace. Consumed by the lineage module via PL_Lineage.

variables.name: LH_Governance_ID
variables.note: Item GUID of the governance lakehouse holding Files/lineage_events and the lineage.* tables. Consumed by the lineage module via PL_Lineage.
